title: PFIC Workbook: Form 8621 for foreign mutual funds and ETFs, lot by lot
pitch: For US taxpayers who hold foreign funds (Indian mutual funds of H-1B and green-card holders, UCITS ETFs of US expats). They enter each purchase lot and the yearly values, and the browser works out the default 1291 or mark-to-market figures per share and fills one IRS Form 8621 PDF per fund. If it takes off, it becomes the yearly filing tool with year-end prices already loaded for every Indian mutual fund (AMFI open data), shared in NRI communities.

evidence.note: NRI guide: cross-border CPAs charge USD 500-2,000 per fund for these calculations, most retail tax software does not support Form 8621, one form per fund
Free calculator: single lot, section 1291 only, no mark-to-market, no QEF, no filled PDF; last reviewed 10 Nov 2026

monetizationIdea: US filers with foreign funds pay 49 EUR per tax year (up to five funds, 10 EUR per extra fund) to get filled 8621 PDFs instead of paying a CPA 200 USD or more per form.
